name: ESF+ Agency Procurement (national Managing Authority tender)
note: ESF+ is delivered ~89% via shared management. Most calls run by national/regional Managing Authorities as public procurement under Directive 2014/24/EU (the EU rules transposed in each MS). This template models the standard three-envelope tender file. The direct-managed EaSI strand on the F&T Portal uses the General MGA template instead.

documents.title: Envelope A: Administrative documentation (ESPD + capacity proofs)

sub.label: A.1.1 Legal entity declaration
prompts: Provide the full legal name, registered address, VAT number, and legal form of the tenderer.
If submitting as a consortium or joint venture, list every participant and identify the lead tenderer.
Attach the LEV (Legal Entity Validation) form signed by the legal representative.

sub.label: A.1.2 Power of attorney
prompts: Attach the power of attorney delegating authority to the person signing the offer, if the signatory is not the statutory representative.
Specify the scope of the delegation (this tender procedure, this lot, framework duration).

sub.label: A.2.1 Exclusion grounds (Article 57 Directive 2014/24)
prompts: Declare absence of convictions for participation in a criminal organisation, corruption, fraud, terrorist offences, money laundering or human trafficking, child labour.
Declare absence of unpaid taxes or social security contributions in any MS.
Declare absence of insolvency, bankruptcy or winding-up procedures.
Declare absence of grave professional misconduct in the last three years.
Note: where exclusion grounds apply, you may provide self-cleaning evidence under Article 57(6).

sub.label: A.2.2 Selection criteria: economic and financial standing
prompts: Report turnover for the last three financial years (consolidated where applicable).
Demonstrate the minimum turnover threshold set in the call, typically twice the estimated annual contract value.
Attach audited financial statements or equivalent for the last three years.
If relying on the capacity of other entities, attach their commitment (Article 63 Directive 2014/24).

sub.label: A.2.3 Selection criteria: technical and professional ability
prompts: List principal services delivered in the last three years comparable in scope to this tender.
Provide reference letters or certificates of satisfactory completion for at least three projects.
Demonstrate the educational and professional qualifications of the key personnel.
Describe quality assurance certifications held (ISO 9001, EN ISO 17100 for language services, social-services certifications where applicable).

sub.label: A.3.1 Declaration of absence of conflict
prompts: Declare that the tenderer, its directors, partners, and key personnel have no personal, financial or family interest in the contracting authority that could compromise their independence.
Disclose any subcontractor relationships with the contracting authority over the past two years.
Where a potential conflict exists, describe the mitigation measures proposed.

documents.title: Envelope B: Technical Offer (methodology + ESF+ alignment)

sub.label: B.1.1 Offer at a glance
prompts: Summarise the proposed service: scope, target group, geography, duration.
State the ESF+ specific objective and OP priority the action contributes to.
Highlight the three strongest differentiators of your offer.

sub.label: B.2.1 Intervention logic
prompts: Describe the intervention logic linking the specific objective, target group needs, the chosen activities, the expected outputs, and the result indicators.
Justify the methodological choices against the evidence base for the target group.
Reference relevant ESF+ Annex I common indicators that the action will report against.

sub.label: B.2.2 Activity design
prompts: Break down the service into work packages with clear deliverables, frequency, and unit volumes.
For each activity, identify the delivery channel (face-to-face, hybrid, online) and the rationale.
Address accessibility from the design stage: physical, digital, linguistic, cognitive.

sub.label: B.2.3 Innovation and continuous improvement
prompts: Describe innovative elements beyond standard market practice (peer-led design, digital tools, behavioural-insight techniques, integrated case management).
Explain the continuous improvement loop: data collection, periodic review, course-correction triggers.

sub.label: B.3.1 Phasing and milestones
prompts: Provide a phased plan covering mobilisation, pilot, scale-up, steady-state, and close-out.
Identify the milestones with quantitative thresholds (e.g. number of participants enrolled, number of outputs delivered).
Attach a Gantt chart covering the full contract duration.

sub.label: B.3.2 Risk register
prompts: List the top ten risks with likelihood, impact, mitigation, and owner.
Include data-protection, equality, financial, partnership, and external-dependency risks.
Specify the escalation path to the contracting authority for material risks.

sub.label: B.4.1 Organisational structure
prompts: Provide an organogram showing roles, reporting lines, and decision rights for the contract.
Identify the contract manager and the designated single point of contact for the contracting authority.
Describe the governance forums (steering committee, operational committee) and their cadence.

sub.label: B.4.2 Key personnel CVs
prompts: Provide a one-page CV for each key role identified in the tender specifications.
For each CV, demonstrate the minimum qualification, language, and relevant experience required.
Confirm availability for the contract duration and the minimum FTE commitment.

sub.label: B.4.3 Subcontracting and capacity-sharing
prompts: Identify subcontractors providing more than 10% of the contract value and attach their commitment letters.
Where relying on the capacity of other entities under Article 63 Directive 2014/24, attach the binding commitment.
Describe the supervision arrangements for subcontracted work.

sub.label: B.5.1 Specific objective and Operational Programme priority
prompts: State the ESF+ specific objective (h, i, j, k, l, m, n) that the action contributes to under Article 4 of Regulation 2021/1057.
Map the action to the relevant priority axis of the national or regional Operational Programme.
Cite the relevant call objectives and demonstrate fit.

sub.label: B.5.2 Target group definition and outreach
prompts: Define the target group with the operational eligibility criteria (age, employment status, disability, migration status, etc.).
Estimate the volume of participants and the gender breakdown.
Describe the outreach and referral channels: PES, social services, NGOs, schools, employers.

sub.label: B.5.3 Common indicators (Annex I Regulation 2021/1057)
prompts: List the common output indicators the action will report (e.g. unemployed including long-term unemployed, persons with disabilities, third-country nationals).
List the common result indicators with the measurement timing (immediately on leaving, four weeks after, six months after).
Describe the data collection instrument and the participant-level data system.

sections.label: B.6 Equality, non-discrimination, accessibility and DNSH

sub.label: B.6.1 Gender equality and non-discrimination (Article 6 ESF+)
prompts: Describe how gender equality is mainstreamed in design, delivery, monitoring, and evaluation.
Address intersecting grounds of discrimination explicitly (sex, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation).
Where the action targets a specific group, justify the proportionality and necessity under Article 7 of Directive 2000/78.

sub.label: B.6.2 Accessibility for persons with disabilities
prompts: Apply the European Accessibility Act standard (Directive 2019/882) to digital deliverables.
Describe physical accessibility of venues, reasonable accommodation procedures, and individual support arrangements.
Identify a designated accessibility focal point in the team.

sub.label: B.6.3 Do-No-Significant-Harm assessment
prompts: Apply the DNSH assessment against the six environmental objectives of Regulation 2020/852 (Taxonomy).
Identify any material impacts and the mitigation measures.
Where a service has negligible environmental impact, justify the simplified assessment.

sub.label: B.7.1 GDPR compliance
prompts: Identify the controller, joint controller, and processor relationships under Articles 4, 26, 28 of Regulation 2016/679.
List the categories of personal data processed and the lawful basis under Article 6 and (where relevant) Article 9.
Describe the retention schedule, data subject rights procedure, and the data-protection officer's contact point.

sub.label: B.7.2 Information security
prompts: Describe the technical and organisational measures under Article 32 (encryption, access control, audit logging, backup).
State the breach-notification procedure (within 72 hours to the controller).
Confirm any ISO 27001, SecNumCloud, or equivalent certifications held.

sub.label: B.8.1 Performance reporting
prompts: Describe the periodic reporting cycle (monthly operational, quarterly performance, annual programme).
Identify the indicators reported, the data sources, and the verification means.
Confirm alignment with the contracting authority's monitoring tools (often a national SFC2021 portal feeder).

sub.label: B.8.2 Evaluation arrangements
prompts: Describe the formative and summative evaluation plan, including data collection windows.
If the call requires a counterfactual or theory-based evaluation, outline the design.
Confirm willingness to participate in the OP's mid-term and ex-post evaluation.

sub.label: B.9.1 Continuation beyond contract end
prompts: Describe the strategy to embed the action's outputs in the contracting authority's permanent service offer.
Identify the transfer arrangements for participant case files, intellectual outputs, and tools.
Quantify the expected social return per public euro spent, citing comparable studies.

documents.title: Envelope C: Financial Offer (price breakdown + cost-per-unit)

sub.label: C.1.1 Total offer price
prompts: State the total contract price (excluding VAT) in EUR.
State the equivalent total including the applicable VAT rate.
Confirm that the price is fixed for the contract duration or specify the indexation formula.

sub.label: C.2.1 Personnel costs
prompts: Itemise personnel costs by role: hourly rate, number of hours, total cost.
Apply the 1720 productive-hours convention where the EU unit-cost decision is used.
Confirm compliance with national minimum wage and collective-agreement requirements.

sub.label: C.2.2 Other direct costs
prompts: Itemise travel, subsistence, equipment, subcontracting, and other direct costs.
For each line, state the unit, unit price, and quantity.
Where lump-sum or unit-cost financing applies, cite the relevant Commission decision.

sub.label: C.2.3 Indirect costs
prompts: Calculate indirect costs as a percentage of eligible direct costs (typically 7% or 15% under simplified cost options).
Confirm that no double-funded indirect costs are claimed.
Where actual indirect costs are claimed, describe the allocation methodology.

sub.label: C.3.1 Unit cost per output
prompts: Calculate the average cost per enrolled participant.
Calculate the cost per successful outcome (placement, qualification, sustained employment).
Benchmark against published comparator values where available.
